purpose: Mechanism-discrimination diagnostic for Stage B Rule A: does flattening the injection gain slope (b=0) remove the P0 FPR elevation? Paired to Stage B by world seed (CRN backgrounds).

stageb_reference.note: Stage B formal run (pair-key fixed) provides the paired P0 (b=0.3056, kappa=0) reference arm, joined by world seed.
stageb_reference.role: reference only; Stage B outputs are never written by Stage C

seed_namespace.world_seed_formula: 22360827 + seed_index (identical to Stage B BY DESIGN: CRN background pairing; only the injection gain slope differs)
seed_namespace.pairing_assertion: per-(seed, subject, session, pair) base_fingerprint must equal Stage B's, proving bitwise background/nuisance identity

P0F.role: gain-flattened zero phase-concentration injection; isolates the gain-z_e coupling from the envelope-onset pull

injection.kernel_formula: h(t)=sqrt(2)*sin(pi*(t-0.10)/0.40), t in [0.10,0.50] s, zero outside
injection.phi: one Uniform(-pi,pi) phase per pair (same draw as Stage B: base stream, pre-injection)
injection.epsilon: von Mises(0,0) = Uniform(-pi,pi), arm-local stream keyed SHA256(stageC_contract_sha256|world_seed|P0F|subject|session_id|pair_id|phase_injection)
injection.signal_point: raw 1000-Hz synthetic signal before anti-alias filtering and 250-Hz downsampling
injection.event_subset: all covariate rows with source_complete==1; boundary-invalid windows are skipped

epsilon_resultant_check.level: per-world mean over pairs with epsilon_count>=1000, plus loose per-pair caps
epsilon_resultant_check.rationale: same calibration as Stage B (uniform resultant mean ~0.0203 at n~1900, world-mean SE ~0.0006; observed Stage B P0 world means max 0.0282). Implementation QC, not a scientific gate.

production_mphase.filter: third-order zero-phase Butterworth within each continuous clean block

checkpoint.unit: one world containing the complete P0F arm
checkpoint.format: MATLAB -v7.3; write world_%03d.mat.tmp then atomic move to world_%03d.mat
checkpoint.resume: only a complete checkpoint with exact identity may be reused

inference.subject_reducer: same finite pair rows and subject inclusion for both reducers
inference.paired_contrast: FPR_P0F - FPR_P0(StageB) joined by world seed and run; Newcombe method 10 two-sided 95% CI

preregistered_decision.rule_C1: gain-coupling contribution: the paired Newcombe method-10 95% CI of FPR_P0F - FPR_P0(StageB) has upper bound < 0 in both R1 and R2 (mean reducer).
preregistered_decision.rule_C2: residual elevation: the P0F mean-reducer FPR Clopper-Pearson 95% interval contains 0.05 in both R1 and R2.

mechanism_classes.gain_coupling_dominant: C1 true and C2 true: flattening the gain removes the elevation; the Stage B P0 FPR elevation is attributed to the gain-z_e-local-maxima coupling.
mechanism_classes.both_contribute: C1 true and C2 false: flattening reduces but does not eliminate the elevation; envelope-onset pull (or another mechanism) also contributes.
mechanism_classes.envelope_or_other_dominant: C1 false and C2 false: flattening does not significantly reduce the elevation; the envelope-onset pull or another mechanism dominates.
mechanism_classes.indeterminate: any other combination; report descriptively without a mechanism claim.

preregistered_decision.scope: mechanism diagnostic only; enters no Stage A/B verdict and changes no manuscript efficacy claim by itself
preregistered_decision.median_role: descriptive only, as in Stage B Rule C

validator_checklist: contract/parent/schedule SHA-256 match checkpoint; Stage B outputs are read-only references
exactly 60 checkpoints, unique seeds in the shared namespace, no tmp residue
per-(seed,subject,session,pair) base_fingerprint equals Stage B pair rows (CRN pairing proof)
kappa=0, gain_slope_b=0, A_G06 numeric value and grid_id match contract (both checked)
epsilon uniformity via per-world mean resultant (P0 tolerances) and loose per-pair caps
injection stream seed unique per (seed,subject,session,pair); event-count identities hold
independent mean/median, pair diagnostics, exact sign-flip column-2 p, FPR/CP recomputation
paired Newcombe recomputation from this run's and Stage B's world rows; summary TSVs and decision agree

engineering.performance_budget: single arm: ~530 s/world; 60 worlds estimated 45-60 min at 12 workers
engineering.smoke: 2-world smoke is an implementation check only; never a tuning gate
